decls.name: SublemmaPacking

paper_span.quote: The open polydiscs of sup-norm radius \(D^{-1}/2\) centered at the points of \(X\) are pairwise disjoint

decls.rationale: The volume-comparison packing argument of Lemma 2.6: disjoint polydiscs of sup-norm radius \(D^{-1}/2\) around the points of \(X\) all fit in \(B_{R + D^{-1}/2}\), giving \(|X| \le (1 + 2RD)^{2f}\).
